# ShipIt Unity Toolkits

> ShipIt builds production-grade Unity backends with full C# source, editor
> tooling and evidence-published verification. Works with Unity 2022.3 LTS or
> newer.

## Products

- [ShipIt Unity Supabase Toolkit](https://shipit-unity.github.io/index.html):
  the most complete Supabase integration for Unity — 38 RLS-hardened backend
  packs, full C# source, editor tooling, a multi-provider AI assistant and an
  operator web console. Works with any Supabase project, hosted or
  self-hosted.
  - [Documentation](https://shipit-unity.github.io/documentation.html) · [Live-Ops console](https://shipit-unity.github.io/live-ops.html)
- [ShipIt AWS Toolkit](https://shipit-unity.github.io/aws-toolkit.html):
  AWS for every Unity platform, WebGL included — pure-C# Cognito (SRP + MFA),
  Identity Pools, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, realtime and game systems; no
  aws-sdk-net DLLs, IL2CPP/AOT-safe.
  - [Documentation](https://shipit-unity.github.io/aws-documentation.html)
  - Agent-ready: the package ships `llms.txt`, an agent guide and five task
    skills (setup, auth, WebGL, data, troubleshooting). With Unity's Pipeline
    package (Unity 6+) eleven `aws_*` Unity CLI commands cover the doctor,
    deploy, verify, generation, provisioning, IAM, cost, release and export —
    mutations require `confirm=true`; `dry_run` previews.

## Shared pages

- [Release notes](https://shipit-unity.github.io/updates.html): per-version
  changelog highlights for both toolkits; each package also ships a full
  CHANGELOG.md.
- [Privacy](https://shipit-unity.github.io/privacy.html): no analytics, no
  cookies, no telemetry.
- [Store](https://shipit-unity.github.io/store.html): Asset Store listings.

## Supabase Toolkit — core API surface (C#)

- Initialize: `SupabaseClient.InitializeFromResources();`
- Auth: email/password, magic link, phone OTP, anonymous, OAuth PKCE deep links,
  Apple/Google ID tokens, MFA (TOTP), CAPTCHA, identity linking, GDPR export/delete.
- Database: typed query builder (`From<T>()` with lambda filters), full-text
  search, auto-pagination (`GetAllAsync`), offline cache + mutation replay.
- Realtime: postgres changes, broadcast, presence, private RLS-gated channels,
  native browser WebSocket on WebGL.
- Storage: uploads, resumable TUS with offset recovery, image transforms,
  signed URLs, Texture2D/Sprite/AudioClip loaders, bucket management.
- Edge Functions: typed invoke plus token streaming (`InvokeStreamingAsync`,
  SSE or raw chunks, main-thread callbacks).
- Feature services: QueueService (pgmq), CronService (pg_cron),
  HybridSearchService (RRF fusion), AnalyticsService, CloudSaveService,
  FeatureFlagService, RemoteConfigService, EconomyService, LeaderboardService,
  SecureLeaderboardService, MatchmakingService, TournamentService,
  RankedMatchmakingService, ModerationService, MailboxService, QuestService,
  BattlePassService, SeasonService, WebhookService, ReferralService,
  IdempotencyService, AuditService, RateLimitService, PushTokenService,
  IapValidationService, FriendService, GuildService, InventoryService,
  AchievementService, DailyRewardService, CloudSaveHistoryService,
  SemanticSearchService, RagService, AiChatClient, AiEmbeddingClient.

## AWS Toolkit — core API surface (C#)

- Initialize: `ShipIt.Aws.AwsClient.InitializeFromResources();`
- Auth: password, SRP (the password never leaves the device), MFA/challenge
  continuation, phone OTP (custom auth), Hosted UI OAuth2 + PKCE.
- Identity: `aws.Credentials.GetAsync()` mints short-lived SigV4 credentials.
- Storage: `aws.Storage` upload/download/head/delete, ListObjectsV2,
  presigned GET/PUT URLs, resumable multipart with progress.
- Data: `aws.Data` typed models, reserved-word-safe expression builders,
  Query/Scan, batch and transactional writes, PartiQL.
- Functions: `aws.Functions` signed invokes, response streaming, Function URLs
  for WebGL.
- Game systems: `aws.Game` leaderboards (server-authoritative option), cloud
  saves, feature flags, analytics and the player economy.
- Realtime: `aws.Realtime` IAM-signed `wss://` with an offline send queue and
  bounded reconnect. Offline: `aws.Offline` durable mutation queue.

## Supabase Toolkit — security model

Ship only the anon/publishable key in clients. Service-role keys stay in
machine-local editor preferences and are never written to runtime assets or
builds. Privileged mutations (economy grants, quest progress, battle-pass XP)
are service-role-only Postgres functions. Every bundled pack enables RLS with
explicit policies and function execute allowlists.

## AWS Toolkit — security model

No long-lived keys ever ship in clients: signed calls use temporary Identity
Pool credentials, player rows are scoped to the caller with
`dynamodb:LeadingKeys`, scoring moves server-side with the shipped Lambda
template, and the doctor flags extractable app-client secrets.
